name: Kamiyacho
tagline: Toranomon in 2 minutes and Roppongi in 3 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥180,000 to ¥190,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 13 minutes to Otemachi, 18 minutes to Shinjuku, 17 minutes to Shibuya and 21 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥180,000 to ¥190,000. The station stands 8.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 25.0 m. The land around the station rises and falls sharply.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 8.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 4.3 m to 29.3 m, a difference of 25.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 1 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

groceries.name: 麻布台ヒルズマーケット

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 9 clinics and 11 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 東京慈恵会医科大学附属病院, about 10 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 虎の門病院, about 11 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line runs at 163% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 三ノ輪→入谷, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 1K ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. 1LDK ¥400,000 to ¥410,000 and 2LDK ¥610,000 to ¥620,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Onarimon, but Kamiyacho is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kamiyacho. It reaches Otemachi 6 minutes sooner than Kamiyacho. One-room rents run about ¥20,000 lower.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station rises and falls sharply, and living above or below the slope changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 11 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are some of the most heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
